tools.name: list_app_data_skill_files
tools.title: List App Data Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'app-data' skill, the platform's guidance for persisting data and files durably from an app - app config files, bundled data, user-generated files, per-user saved files, reading files back at runtime, serving stored images, and querying a CSV in memory without a database. Call this when the user asks to save or load app settings, store files permanently, read a bundled data file, show an image stored with the app, or filter/aggregate an uploaded CSV, and when they name SaveAppAssets, GetAppAssets, GetAppAssetsBase64, BrowseAppAssets, SaveUserAssets, CopyAppAssetsToInsight, the space argument, FileRead, CreateFrame, or QueryAll. CRITICAL to consult before any persistence design: it covers which spaces are ephemeral vs durable, why end users cannot write project space, and the assets/public read jail for view-only users. Returns each file with its path, name, and description; start with SKILL.md. Not for S3-style storage engines (see the storage skill) or SQL data (see the database skill).

project.title: project
project.description: The app-data skill (app-data). Always this value.

tools.name: read_app_data_skill_file
tools.title: Read App Data Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'app-data' skill in full, for writing code that persists and reads app or user data through runPixel. Pass filePath exactly as list_app_data_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers the three file spaces (ephemeral insight, durable git-backed project, durable per-user), the two correctness traps (project writes need EDIT permission; view-only users can read only assets/public), the full SaveAppAssets/GetAppAssets family, base64 image serving because project files are not URL-addressable, the space argument path-prefix inconsistency, the FileRead | Import | Frame | QueryAll CSV query flow, and why SetAppConfig is not durable.
